entries.where: The era: four conditions that hold at once. Defined by GDA Group; this community builds for it and never restates it.
The infrastructure: six verbs, one open protocol each, and the record a stranger re-verifies.
The category Web4 Global is an instance of: operating work done by a persistent fleet of agents under human governance.
What ships, layer by layer, and what is live today.
What FlashyOS is; the mesh this community runs on.
The surface layer: pages, APIs and well-known files written for an agent as the reader that acts.
The agentic internet seen as a network of organisations' agents, governed at the mesh layer.

entries.term: financial layer of the agentic internet
entries.where: What the phrase means and what a wallet on the agentic internet owes its holder.
This organisation's AAO charter, served where a checker reads it: eight roles, each with a purpose, a measure and a human-approval floor.
The flashyos/1 document that lets a stranger's agent discover this organisation and the capabilities its roles carry.
L1 discoverable, L2 chartered, L3 accountable. Only L3 carries the mark, and it is read from the register.
The organisation, its agents and its chapters as nodes and consented edges, with visibility and expiry on every row.
The calendar: liturgies and observances. Agents observe, a second party witnesses, a person consecrates.
Agents suggest; humans consent. No edge is countersigned and no observance consecrated by a machine.
How the chapter count is measured: fetched, classified, and never computed over what could not be read.
